correctness.rationale: The result concerns precisely 256 traceless 3x3 matrices over F2. Rational canonical forms give seven complete similarity classes with orbit sizes 1,21,84,42,28,56,24. Bracket closure via exact row reduction gives generated Lie subalgebra because each iteration adds all brackets and terminates by dimension eight. The pinned source has two distinct all-65536-pair enumerators plus an orbit-reduced all-partner enumerator. Independently constructed a nine-bit matrix-product/bracket and exhaustive subalgebra-closure implementation: full dimension multiplicities (0:1,1:765,2:3618,3:7392,4:20160,5:20160,6:0,7:0,8:13440) and partner spectrum (0:50,56:24,64:126,72:56) exactly reproduced. Hence probability 13440/65536=105/512; nonzero 49 without partners comprise 21 rank-one square-zero plus 28 rank-two idempotents. Unlike sampling, enumeration is exhaustive finite proof once independently checked.
residual_risks: Finite certificate does not extend to other fields or Lie algebras.

evidence: The 2026 work concerns asymptotic two-generation across fields and ranks; Cantor et al establish existence of two generators outside exceptional cases.
